audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-written renekton__yorick mirror, which sets rows 0, 3 and 4 to Renekton and row 6 to Yorick. whys[3] also described level 6 while sitting in the Levels 4-5 row.
audit.why: Renekton owns the entire laning phase: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s so chip is refunded, Ruthless Predator stuns for 1.5s at full Fury, and Slice and Dice is back every 10-16s. Level 6 adds Dominus on 120s. It only ends at two items, when Yorick's side lane and Maiden take towers Renekton has to answer in person.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Renekton x6 then Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side as one paired group, ratings 3/3/3/3/3/4/6. whys[3], whys[4] and whys[6] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the matchup 'never names any of Renekton's abilities'. spikes[0].text calls his heal 'Dice (Q)' and reduces his combo to 'dash-slice-dash (E-W-E)'. No cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Dice is half of Slice and Dice (E). His Q is Cull the Meek, a flat 7s heal-on-damage; W is Ruthless Predator, 16/14/12/10/8s; E is Slice and Dice, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 450 range; R is Dominus, 120/100/80s. Fury doubles the Q heal and extends the W stun to 1.5s, so 'wait the Fury bar out' is only actionable with the numbers attached.
audit.corrected: All five abilities named correctly with real cooldowns across spikes[0..3].text, phases[0..5].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields say Renekton dashes past or ignores Dark Procession: wants.foe[1] ('Dash over your cage with E'), spikes[2].text ('ignore your cage') and mid ('dashes past your cage'). Nothing mentions that Ruthless Predator is an auto reset, or that its empowered form strips shields.
audit.why: Riot's Dark Procession text is a destructible wall that 'will block enemy movement', and the kit file's terrain flag says the same — it blocks paths and dashes. Slice and Dice is a dash, so the wall stops it. That inverts the advice: the cage is the correct answer to his mobility, placed on his escape route, not a spell he ignores. Two further unstated pieces from Riot's own text: Ruthless Predator resets his auto (so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast) and at over 50 Fury it destroys damage shields on the target as well as stunning for 1.5s. And Cull the Meek heals every 7s, doubled at full Fury, which is why Grievous Wounds decides the extended trade.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1], spikes[2].text and mid rewritten so the cage blocks Slice and Dice. Auto-reset tell added to phases[1].why, report[5].t and spikes[0].text; the shield strip to dontsFull[1].d and spikes[1].text; the 7s heal and anti-heal timing to breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0].d, phases[0].why and breakdown.late.

edits.before: You have nothing yet — just bank graves off the wave. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Renekton must walk into your engage range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his: Slice and Dice is back every 13s at rank 3, and Cull the Meek refunds your chip every 7s. Farm and wait.

edits.before: Maiden turns the lane into a permanent 2v1. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Renekton's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus grants bonus health and area damage on 120s — do not contest 6. Bank graves until it has run out.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ruthless Predator's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force lands, but he still leads — commit only once Ruthless Predator has been spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Renekton carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and the side lane is yours: split away from him, and let Maiden take the towers he has to answer alone.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — a 300-range stun on 16s, 1.5s when empowered, resetting his auto. Track it before every engage. - Cull the Meek: 7s and it heals — buy Grievous Wounds. - Eulogy: kill windows only.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 300-range stun on 16s, 1.5s at full Fury — engage after he spends it.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Bait it. When it is down — Cage + swarm him.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator stuns on 16s, 1.5s at full Fury, and resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: That is Renekton's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s and full Fury doubles it — wait the bar out.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empowered Ruthless Predator also strips your damage shields.

edits.before: Maiden turns the lane into a permanent 2v1 — build your teamfight around that. Renekton carry threat: 8.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles makes every fight a 2v1 — build around it. Renekton carry threat: 8.5/10 — Cull the Meek heals every 7s, so anti-heal stays core; split rather than duel him.

edits.before: Renekton bullies you with Dice (Q) sustain and dash-slice-dash (E-W-E) burst before your ghouls exist. He can dodge your E and all-in your low-fury windows. Play back, farm with Q, and don't trade until ghouls are up.
edits.after: Renekton bullies you before ghouls exist: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s and Slice and Dice dashes in at 450 range on 16s, with Ruthless Predator resetting his auto between. Play back, farm with Last Rites, and never trade at low ghoul count.

edits.before: His empowered R stun and fury combo can kill you outright at 6 if you're caught without cage. Save W for his engage and E to slow his escape. Your R is defensive here, not a kill button.
edits.after: Dominus grants bonus health and area damage on 120s at rank 1, and full Fury turns Ruthless Predator into a 1.5s stun that also strips shields. Cage his retreat, never his path in.

edits.before: Renekton's early item and dash mobility let him ignore your cage and pick trades on his terms. Bait his fury, then cage-and-swarm when it's empty. Shove and roam if he freezes on you.
edits.after: Dark Procession blocks movement, so Slice and Dice cannot dash through it — cage the escape route once his Fury bar is empty, then bring the swarm. Shove and roam if he freezes on you.

edits.before: Renekton falls off while you scale, but a fed Renekton still one-shots you in skirmishes. Keep ghouls and Maiden between you, split-push to punish his weak sidelane. Avoid isolated fights.
edits.after: Renekton falls off while you scale; split opposite him and let the Walkers take his side lane. Keep ghouls and Maiden between you, and never take an isolated fight while his Fury is full.

edits.before: With his power spike online, Renekton dashes past your cage and bursts you in skirmishes. Your counterplay is baiting an empty fury bar, then swarming. He still holds the tempo edge here.
edits.after: He still holds the tempo edge, but Dark Procession blocks movement — Slice and Dice does not dash through it. Bait an empty Fury bar, cage the escape, then swarm him with the ghouls.

edits.before: Renekton fades as you hit full ghoul-and-Maiden scaling, but a fed one remains lethal in isolation. Split opposite him, force sidelane pressure, and only fight with your swarm assembled. Avoid open picks.
edits.after: Renekton fades as you hit full ghoul-and-Maiden scaling, but a fed one stays lethal in isolation. Split opposite him, force side-lane pressure, and only fight with your swarm assembled and his Fury bar empty.

edits.after: Dash in with E for the stun

notes: Biggest correction: three fields told the player Renekton dashes over or ignores Dark Procession. Riot's text for the wall is that it blocks enemy movement, and Slice and Dice is a dash — so the cage is the answer to his mobility, not a spell he bypasses. Ability-name error fixed: 'Dice (Q)' for the heal; his Q is Cull the Meek and Dice is the second half of Slice and Dice (E). Newly stated from Riot's text: Ruthless Predator is an auto reset, and above 50 Fury it destroys damage shields as well as stunning 1.5s. Kit flag misfire as elsewhere: yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) 'dash'; Riot's text gives Yorick no movement, so no dash asserted.
